designationHistory.indexText: Big Stone National Wildlife Refuge was established when the Army Corps of Engineers transferred 10,540 acres bought for the Big Stone Lake-Whetstone River flood-control project to the Fish and Wildlife Service.

authority.citation: Transfer from the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers; Fish and Wildlife Coordination Act and other authorities
